text: No. P-45021/112/2020-PP (BE-11)/016 Government of India Ministry of Commerce and Industry Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (Public Procurement Section) Udyog Bhawan , New Delhi Dated the 1ih Apr, 2024 Registration Certificate to M/s Datong Xincheng New Material Co. Ltd. The undersigned is directed to refer to the application no . NIL dated 27 .10.2023 of M/s Datong Xincheng New Material Co. Ltd seeking registration in accordance with Department of Expenditure Order (Public Procurement No.4) No. F. 7/10/2021-PPD dated 23.02.2023 and to convey that competent authority has approved grant of registration on the following terms and conditions to the entity mentioned below: Name of the applicant entity M/s Datong Xincheng New Material Co. Ltd. Registered Office/Complete address Huayuantun Economic Development Zone, of the manufacturing premises Datong, Shanxi, China Contact Person: Grace Tel:0086-352-3175088 Email: world258@126.com ltem(s) for which registration is Graphite Mould Blank granted Validity of registration 01 year from the date of issue of this letter, i.e., 11 th April, 2025 2. The Registration is only for the purpose of participation in public procurement in India in accordance with DoE Orqer (Public Procurement No.4) dated 23.02 .2023 for the supply of items (goods/works/services/ToT arrangement) from the premises mentioned above. 3. In case of appointment of new Director(s)/shareholders with more than 10% shares /change in controlling ownership interest or control through other means, this Registration shall automatically stand annulled. s:W)~'ntf-i To, (Surendra Singh) Under Secretary to the Government of India E-mail: ssingh .dopt@nic.in Ph:- 011-23061592 M/s Datong Xincheng New Material Co. Ltd.
